rationale: Increased U-Net channels c=24 -> c=64 (params 0.9 M -> 3.6 M). Val score dropped from 0.58 to 0.55: the model is too large for the 400-phantom subset and starts to overfit. Discarding.
advice_for_others: Quadrupling parameters on a small training set degrades val score immediately — Don't try larger models without first adding regularisation.
